description: concat joins the element types of its two lists, so a record with fewer fields can join a list of larger records, and the fields some lack read as optional.
program: (let [orders (call orders.list {}) all (concat orders [{:customer "walk-in"}]) more (concat [{:id "a" :size 1}] [{:id "b" :note "late"}])] {:totals (map (fn [o] (get o :total 0)) all) :more (map (fn [r] [(get r :id) (get r :size 0) (get r :note "none")]) more) :count (count all)})
